items.title: Skipped monorepo deployments no longer count against limits
items.summary: Deployments that Vercel  in a monorepo no longer count against your deployment rate limits. Teams with monorepos now get more deployments from the same limits.automatically skipsVercel skips a project's deployment when its source code and internal dependencies haven't changed, using 's package graph and lockfile analysis to determine which projects a commit affects.
